d: National park in Chiang Mai, Thailand
x: Pha Daeng National Park, formerly known as Chiang Dao National Park, is a national park in Chiang Mai Province, Thailand. The park covers 702,085 rai ~ 1,123 square kilometres of the Pha Daeng mountain areas of the Daen Lao Range near the border with Burma, just north of Chiang Dao Wildlife Sanctuary. The tallest summit is 1,794 m high Doi Puk Phakka.

The Tasang Dam, also known as the Mong Ton Dam, is a planned multi-purpose dam on the Salween River in the Shan State, Myanmar. The Tasang dam's location will be 480 km northeast of Rangoon and 52.8 km west of Mongtong.

d: Protected area in Chiang Mai Province, Thailand
x: Chiang Dao Wildlife Sanctuary is a protected area in Chiang Mai Province, Thailand. Established on 25 August 1978, the sanctuary covers 521 km2 of the Doi Chiang Dao and southern mountainous regions of the Daen Lao Range, north of the Thanon Thong Chai Range. The tallest summit is 2,175 m high Doi Chiang Dao.

d: Buddhist cave temple in Chiang Mai province, Thailand
x: Wat Tham Chiang Dao, also known as Wat Tham Luang Chiang Dao, is a Buddhist temple at the foot of Doi Luang Chiang Dao in Chiang Dao district, Chiang Mai province, Thailand.
